notes_for_editor: Thin sourcing. Two WebSearch queries plus cached pages yield only name, county, coordinates, standing status and OSM elevation. No build date, builder, design, height, staffing, access or rental source found. Record matches FFLA and OSM on name, county, location and status; no corrections proposed. The central US lookout list page names Lugerville (Price County) with no detail. Search returned the Fifield tower (Price County, a different structure) and Wisconsin Historical Society records for Lugerville houses; neither describes this tower, so neither is cited. WXPR and FFLA 2019 items are statewide context only. Leads: Wisconsin Historical Society Architecture and History Inventory, WDNR tower divestment records, Price County Historical Society, Chequamegon-Nicolet National Forest office (to check whether the tower sits on national forest land). Confirm land ownership before any access advice.
